sections.text: I Smite in the Supreme Queen's Name!

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 5x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 170. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: yourself. Applies Emerald King's Crest for 120 seconds ([Heraldic] Increases max HP by 500%, increases DEF and MDEF by 100%, increases ATK and MATK for all allies by 100%. Only one Heraldic effect may be active at a time (between both allies and enemies). When a new Heraldic effect is activated, the older effect will be removed. This effect is not affected by Time Slice or Time Extend).
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Lowers the effect of Unison gauge reduction by 50% when equipped in the main slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Water and Star Defense from Unison Damage +700
